name: Promptor
author: Corrplus

sections.description:
Try AI on your website in under 60 seconds — no API key required.

See real answers from your own content. No setup, no configuration, no credit card.

Promptor turns your WordPress site into an AI-powered sales assistant that answers questions, recommends services, and captures leads — all based on your actual content.

Unlike generic chatbots, Promptor reads your pages and posts. It knows what you offer, speaks in your context, and helps visitors take the next step.

New in 2.0: a completely redesigned admin, a beautiful new chat widget, and dark mode for both. Choose Light, Dark, or Auto and everything follows — the panel you work in and the chat your visitors see.

Live Demo

See Promptor in action:
https://promptorai.com/demo

Experience how the AI answers real questions, recommends services, and captures leads.

See it working instantly

  1. Activate the plugin and start the free trial (no API key needed)
  2. Select up to 3 pages to train the AI on
  3. Ask a question and see a real answer from your own content

That’s it. No sign-ups. No configuration. No credit card.

What’s New in 2.0

  • A brand-new chat widget — Softer message bubbles, a refreshed header and polished recommendation cards, in the brand colors you already chose
  • Dark mode, everywhere — Light, Dark, or Auto for both your admin panel and the chat your visitors see
  • A redesigned admin — One consistent panel with clear navigation, so every screen feels like part of the same product
  • Knowledge bases as cards — Browse them in a visual grid and manage, sync or copy a shortcode from one place
  • Save & Sync in one click — A guided flow that sets up a knowledge base for you, without hunting through menus
  • Answers in plain language — See what a visitor asked, what Promptor answered, and every service, product, article and FAQ it recommended, each one a link

Everything you already set up — your colors, knowledge bases, leads and settings — carries over exactly as it was.

What Promptor does for your business

  • Answers visitor questions 24/7 — based on your actual pages, posts, and services
  • Captures leads inside the chat — visitors share their details naturally during conversation
  • Turns visitors into leads — guide users toward booking, inquiry, or purchase
  • Responds in the visitor’s language — the AI automatically matches the language of the question

Who is Promptor for?

  • Service businesses that lose leads to slow response times
  • Founders who need to qualify leads outside business hours
  • Local businesses that want to answer common questions automatically
  • Agencies adding AI-powered engagement to client websites
  • WooCommerce stores recommending products through conversation (Pro)

Free Features

  • No API Key Trial — Start instantly with 25 free AI queries, no OpenAI account needed
  • Mini Knowledge Base — Train AI on up to 3 pages during trial or with your own API key
  • Suggested Questions — Onboarding generates sample questions so you see results immediately
  • Real Content Answers — AI responds based on your actual pages, not generic training
  • Save & Sync — Pick your pages and Promptor builds the knowledge base for you in one click
  • Lead Capture — Collect visitor contact information directly inside the chat
  • Lead Inbox — View recent inquiries in the WordPress admin
  • Plain-Language Answer Details — See exactly what was asked, answered and recommended, with links
  • AI Cost Guardrails — Set daily and monthly spending limits with automatic model fallback
  • Shortcode Widget — Place [promptor_search] anywhere on your site
  • Quick Start Wizard — Step-by-step onboarding gets you running in minutes
  • Streaming Answers — Replies type out live, word by word
  • Answers in Any Language — The AI replies in the language your visitor writes in
  • Dark Mode — Light, Dark, or Auto for both the admin panel and the chat widget
  • Brand Customization — Adjust colors, heading, subtitle and placeholder text to match your site

How It Works

Step 1: Start the trial or connect your API key
Activate the plugin and choose: try instantly with 25 free queries, or enter your OpenAI API key for unlimited use.

Step 2: Select pages to train on
Pick the pages that describe your business. The AI reads them and uses the content to answer visitor questions accurately.

Step 3: Add the widget to your site
Place the [promptor_search] shortcode on any page. Visitors start asking questions and the AI responds based on your content.

Upgrade to Pro

The free version is fully functional. Pro removes limits and adds tools for scaling:

  • Unlimited Knowledge Base — Train AI on all your pages, posts, products, and PDFs
  • Website Crawler — Automatically index your entire site
  • Popup Widget — Floating chat button on every page
  • WooCommerce Integration — Product recommendations, add-to-cart, inventory awareness
  • Analytics Dashboard — Track queries, leads, conversion rates, and revenue
  • AI Lead Scoring — Automatically classify leads as Hot, Warm, or Cold
  • Email and Slack Alerts — Get notified when new leads arrive
  • Webhooks — Connect to Zapier, Make, or custom automation
  • White Label — Remove “Powered by Promptor” branding

Learn more about Pro

Privacy and Data Handling

OpenAI API:
When using your own API key, user queries and selected content are sent to OpenAI to generate responses. During the free trial, queries are routed through a Promptor-managed proxy that uses OpenAI on your behalf. Review OpenAI’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Telemetry (Optional):
The free version includes optional anonymous telemetry to help improve the plugin. It is disabled by default and requires explicit opt-in. When enabled, only aggregate statistics are collected (setup progress, KB counts, query totals). No personally identifiable information is ever collected. See our Privacy Policy.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality.

1. OpenAI API

  • Purpose: Generate AI chat responses and semantic embeddings
  • Data Sent: User queries, selected page content, API key (when using your own key)
  • When: Every chat interaction and knowledge base sync
  • Terms: OpenAI Terms of Use
  • Privacy: OpenAI Privacy Policy

2. Promptor Trial Service (Free Trial Only)

  • Purpose: Provide AI responses during the free trial without requiring an API key
  • Data Sent: User queries and selected page content (routed through a managed proxy)
  • When: During trial chat interactions only
  • Privacy: Promptor Privacy Policy

3. Promptor Telemetry API (Optional, Disabled by Default)

  • Purpose: Collect anonymous usage statistics to improve the free version
  • Data Sent: Setup status, KB counts, query/lead totals (numbers only), plugin/WP/PHP versions, anonymous UUID
  • Data NOT Sent: Site URLs, IP addresses, emails, content, queries, or any PII
  • When: Twice daily via WP-Cron, only when explicitly enabled
  • Control: Enable/disable anytime in Settings > Telemetry
  • Privacy: Promptor Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Promptor”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. Follow the setup wizard — choose “Try instantly” for the free trial or enter your OpenAI API key

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the .zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate and follow the setup wizard

First-Time Setup

  1. Activate the plugin — the setup wizard opens automatically
  2. Choose “Try Promptor instantly” (no API key) or enter your OpenAI API key
  3. Select pages to train the AI on
  4. Add [promptor_search] to any page or post
  5. Start chatting with your AI assistant
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key to use Promptor?

No. You can start immediately with the free trial — 25 AI queries, no API key required. The trial lets you select up to 3 pages, train the AI, and test it with your own content. When you’re ready for unlimited use, add your own OpenAI API key in Settings.

What happens after the free trial?

After 25 queries, the trial ends. Add your OpenAI API key to continue using Promptor with no query limits. Your settings and content selections are preserved.

Does the AI use my website content or generic responses?

Promptor reads and uses your actual pages and posts. During trial, selected pages are used to generate real answers. With your API key, the full knowledge base is indexed for more accurate responses.

How much does the OpenAI API cost?

OpenAI charges based on usage. A typical conversation costs $0.01-$0.10 depending on length and model. Promptor includes AI Cost Guardrails to help you set spending limits and control costs.

How do I display the chat on my site?

Use the shortcode [promptor_search] on any page or post. Pro also includes a floating popup widget that appears on all pages.

Does this work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. Promptor works with any standard WordPress theme including Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, Neve, and default themes. CSS isolation prevents style conflicts.

How many leads can I capture?

Unlimited in both free and Pro versions. Lead capture has no restrictions.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

Free includes AI chat, lead capture, the no-API-key trial, and up to 3 knowledge base items. Pro removes limits and adds WooCommerce integration, analytics, automation, and white-label branding.

What languages does Promptor support?

The AI automatically responds in the visitor’s language. Admin interface text supports standard WordPress translations (.po/.mo files).

Can Promptor replace a contact form?

Yes. Many sites use Promptor as a conversational alternative to traditional forms. Visitors ask questions, get instant answers, and share their contact details naturally — resulting in higher engagement and more qualified leads.

Why does the free version have telemetry?

Telemetry is optional, disabled by default, and only collects anonymous aggregate statistics. It helps us understand which features matter most so we can improve the plugin. You can enable or disable it anytime in Settings > Telemetry.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

Fixed: chat answers could appear as raw code

  • Fixed: when the assistant was powered through the WordPress AI Client, answers could appear in the chat as a block of raw code instead of a readable reply, and no service or product recommendations were shown. Answers now read normally whichever AI provider your site uses.
  • Improved: Promptor now asks the WordPress AI Client for a structured reply directly, and falls back automatically when a provider does not offer that — so the chat keeps working either way.
  • Improved: if a reply is ever cut short or cannot be read, the chat now shows a readable message instead of technical output.

2.0.0

Promptor 2.0 — A Brand-New Experience, Inside and Out

This is the biggest release since launch: a completely redesigned admin, a beautiful new chat widget, and dark mode everywhere. Everything you already set up — your colors, knowledge bases, leads and settings — carries over exactly as it was.

New:

  • A redesigned admin, top to bottom — one consistent, app-style panel with a shared header and clear top navigation, so every screen feels like part of the same product
  • A new dashboard — your most important numbers front and center on clean stat cards, with the day-to-day actions you actually use right beside them
  • Knowledge bases as cards — browse them in a visual grid and manage, sync, or copy a shortcode from one place, without hunting through menus
  • A rebuilt AI Conversations view — every conversation reads like a real chat, with its knowledge base, response speed, usage and cost shown at a glance
  • A brand-new chat widget for your visitors — softer message bubbles, a refreshed header, cleaner recommendation cards and a more inviting input box, all in the brand colors you already chose
  • Dark mode, everywhere — pick Light, Dark, or Auto (follows the device setting) for both your admin and the chat widget your visitors see
  • Friendlier controls throughout — modern on/off switches and clean segmented buttons replace the old fiddly options
  • Answer details in plain language — open a submission or a conversation and you see what the visitor asked, what Promptor answered, and the services, products, articles and FAQs it recommended, each one a link straight to that item. No more raw technical output

Improved:

  • A refreshed setup wizard that makes first-time setup faster and clearer
  • Long lists, tables and filters are easier to scan and comfortable to read on any screen size
  • Plugin updates now finish on their own — no more deactivating and reactivating after an update
  • The live preview on the appearance screen now updates the moment you change something, so you can see the result before you save
  • The Support Forum link opens in a new tab and leaves your site open behind it

Fixed:

  • The Submissions screen could show a lead count while the list itself appeared empty after an update
  • Bulk actions on the AI Conversations screen did nothing on the newest version of WordPress
  • Turning off your last notification trigger was not saved
  • Answers containing accented characters could show stray symbols instead of the correct letters
  • The widget theme could not be switched away from Light
  • Deleting a knowledge base now removes it from the list right away, instead of leaving it on screen until you reload

1.5.0

Release Date: August 2026

Streaming Responses:
* AI answers now appear word-by-word as they are generated, with a live typing cursor — even on hosting that buffers output
* Automatic fallback to classic responses when streaming is unavailable; can be disabled in Settings > AI Behavior

Multiple AI Providers (WordPress AI Client):
* Choose your AI: keep using OpenAI directly, or let WordPress 7.0+ handle it so you can answer with OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude) or Google (Gemini)
* Provider keys live in one place — WordPress Settings > Connectors — and Promptor picks them up automatically
* The settings screen adapts to your choice and takes you straight to the right WordPress page

Smarter Models:
* The model list updates itself — when OpenAI releases a new model, it simply appears in your settings, with no clutter from test or legacy versions
* Works out of the box with the newest OpenAI models, including the gpt-5 family
* Fixed: the model you pick in settings is now always the model that answers

Smarter Free Trial:
* 25 free AI queries (up from 10) and up to 3 pages of your content
* The AI now always answers in the language of your content — even if the visitor asks in another language
* Suggested questions are generated in your content’s language (10 languages supported)
* Trial limits shown in the admin always match your actual remaining quota

Lead Capture, Fixed:
* New in-chat contact form appears when visitors ask about pricing or contact, or after a few answers — configurable in UI Settings
* Setup wizard now marks pages as services so AI recommendations and the quote form actually trigger
* Re-running the wizard no longer erases content roles you set in Knowledge Base Manage

Refreshed Chat Design:
* Timestamps and the copy button moved below each message, so answers use the full chat width on phones and in the popup
* Smoother, more polished message animations

Under the Hood:
* Requires PHP 8.0+; tested up to WordPress 7.1
* Meets the latest official WordPress plugin quality and security standards
* GDPR: personal data export and erasure via WordPress Privacy tools
* Word counts and language handling fixed for Turkish and other non-ASCII languages
* Knowledge Base counters refresh immediately after sync and clear
* Design improvements show up immediately after every update — no need to clear caches
* Scheduled telemetry now runs reliably (opt-in, anonymous as always)
* Uninstall removes all plugin tables, including embeddings

1.4.0

Major update: Try AI instantly (no API key required)

Instant AI Trial:

  • Start without an OpenAI API key — 25 free queries included
  • One-click trial activation in the setup wizard
  • Test with your own content immediately

Mini Knowledge Base:

  • Select up to 3 pages to train your AI during trial
  • Real answers generated from your actual content
  • Suggested questions included for instant testing

AI Behavior System:

  • Persona and tone controls for AI responses
  • Per-knowledge-base behavior overrides
  • Live behavior preview in settings

Improved Onboarding:

  • Trial-first setup wizard — no API key barrier
  • Clear trial status on settings and welcome pages
  • Smooth transition to your own API key when ready
  • Trial exhaustion messages guide users to add their key

Reliability & Improvements:

  • Improved overall stability and WordPress compatibility
  • AI now responds in the visitor’s language during trial
  • Clearer setup and status messages across the plugin
  • Smoother onboarding experience from install to first answer
  • Optional anonymous usage insights (opt-in, no personal data)

1.3.5

Release Date: March 17, 2026

New Features (Pro):
* Inventory-Aware AI Recommendations — AI now knows product stock status and prioritizes in-stock items
* Product Comparison Table — Side-by-side comparison table when AI recommends 2+ products
* Stock Badges — “Out of Stock” and “Low Stock” badges on product cards
* Cart Reminder — Nudge visitors to complete purchases when they have items in cart
* WooCommerce Display Settings — Admin controls for comparison, stock badges, and cart reminder

* Copy Message Button — One-click copy icon on AI responses for easy sharing

Accessibility:

* ARIA Labels — Screen reader support for chat log, input field, send button, and all interactive elements
* Focus Trap — In popup mode, Tab focus stays within the chat widget
* Focus-visible Styles — Clear keyboard focus indicators on all interactive elements

Mobile UX:
* Input Auto-Resize — Textarea automatically grows as you type longer messages (max 120px)
* Consistent Touch Targets — 44px minimum touch target on all buttons and interactive elements

Performance:

Bug Fixes:

Improvements:

Release Date: March 6, 2026

New Features:
* AI Cost Guardrails — Never worry about surprise API bills again. Set daily and monthly spending limits, receive email alerts at 80%, 90%, and 100% usage, and let the plugin automatically switch to a more affordable model when you approach your budget. Configure everything from the new Settings > AI Usage tab.
* Dark Mode — Work the way you prefer. Choose between Dark, Light, or Auto (follows your system setting) from UI Settings. Every admin page is beautifully styled in both themes.

* (Pro) Submissions Archive & Filters — Keep your leads organized with archive/unarchive actions, date range filtering, and score-based filtering (High/Medium/Low). Toggle between Active and Archived views just like your email inbox.

* Modern Toast Notifications — No more jarring browser popups. All admin notifications now appear as sleek, non-intrusive toast messages.
* Smarter Error Messages — When something goes wrong, both you and your visitors see clear, helpful messages instead of cryptic errors.
* Knowledge Base Management — Improved action buttons with helpful tooltips and better layout make managing your knowledge bases easier than ever.
* Under-the-Hood Reliability — Extensive code modernization with 111 automated tests ensures rock-solid stability. Your chat widget is now faster, more reliable, and thoroughly tested.
* Full WordPress Plugin Check compliance for security and coding standards

Bug Fixes:

Improvements:

* Enhanced Welcome Page – Redesigned with progress tracking and contextual guidance

Bug Fixes:
